description: 한국방송통신전파진흥원_우량경보 무선국 정보 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국방송통신전파진흥원. 본 데이터는 사용자가 주소 정보를 입력하면 해당 지역에서 우량경보 무선국 정보 및 주파수 정보를 제공합니다. 데이터의 포멧은 JSON이고 매월 제공됩니다. 입력값 기본인자는 인증키, 호출서비스 구분, 호출 타입, 페이지 위치, 페이지당 요청 숫자, 아래 요청인자 참조입니다. 입력값 요청인자는 시도코드와... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국방송통신전파진흥원. Its tags are 정보통신, 위성전파, 기지국, 주파수, API. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-11-06 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
